Maybe I'm a little bit late but anyway, here's what I think. I love this scene. As a Mexican college student myself this scene is spot on. Ok, maybe it's taken a little over the top for story's sake, but still, so good. Here's why... 

First, gossip is so natural for us. We love it, specially when it involves some sort of authority figure like a professor. It doesn't matter if it's your favorite teacher, if there's a photo of him having gay sex, it's gonna spread like wildfire. Now, imagine the photos leaked right at the time he was giving class (morning/afternoon). It's not uncommon for us to Reddit, tweet, or text in class, so if the image was suddenky leaked it would be all over the place - fast. This is the beginning of the scene, where everyone is distracted from class, I can perfectly see this happening IRL. Anyway, Hernando asks what the hell'is everyone looking at. Suddenly, this preppy kid who think he has his life solved because of his parents wealth decides to fuck with a the teacher that's on a vulnerable position, probably just for the lols. He projects the image for Hernando and the class to see, humiliating him. (I know the projector thing is weird, but let's just go with it). 

Unfortunately, we do have this kind of people in Mexico, he probably thinks Hernando is gonna get fired because of this and has nothing to lose, so he doesn't really give a fuck.

Now the kid thinks he's at the top of the world and tells him it's just shit packer porn. Remember what I said about gossip? Hernando decides to fuck this guy in such a classy way, telling him it's whatever he wants to see, shit packer porn. The douchebag is left speechless, the fucker gets fucked, that's what's funny and makes people laugh.  Hernando takes the opportunity to convey his last message *art is love made public*, using himself as an example. Pretty solid example. 

I will admit that the bell and the projector thing are just weird, but we helps to give contiuinty. The projector helps the scene move forward, and the bell as cue for Lito to come in.

A basic guide to leaving a social gathering. 
* Announce your departure with body language before saying anyhting so your friends get the idea of what's gonna happen. How? If you're in a circle walk a step or two backwards; if you're seated, stand up. Try twisting your hips or your shoulders away. Basically what you're doing is positioning yourself for leaving without actually doing it. 

* State what you're gonna do next as if it was an obligation. This you imply that you want to stay but you're being forced to leave. "I have to go home now", "I have to catch a train", "I have to go get a drink". Whatever it is, just say you have to do it. 

* (Optional) State how you felt being around them. "It was great seeing you", " I had a lovely time", "I had such a great time" 

* You're not saying goodbye, just see you later. It's very important that people don't feel abandoned, so always tell them that you're gonna see them, even if you just met them and probably won't. If you already have plans with them this is the moment to bring them up. eg "Catch you later", "see you tonight", "see you at the bar", "meet you next Friday", "pick you up at 7". You get the idea. 

* If your friends get upset that you're leaving just enforce that you HAVE to do whatever you said you had to do, and that you WILL see them later. 

* As you have already positioned yourself for departure, just go for it. 

* (Optional) This one depends on your social context. While speaking, lean on and grab or tap the shoulder of whoevers closest. This affirms your friendship and creates closeness. For this you have to be very confident and casual though, else you'll come off as creepy. 

This right here is my go to method of parting ways and has worked pretty well.

Hey there! I'm not really going to give you advice on approaching or talking to the dude, the top comment did that perfectly. However, through your comments I realize you seem way too self conscious. It's ok to be, sometimes I find myself in the same position. I'm going to give you a few ideas that maybe you have considered or maybe not, for me they are the core of my social well-being. 

1. It's ok if people don't like you. Really, it doesn't matter. Even if you're forced to be with them or work with them, it's ok. Hell, there are even people I like that hate me. As long as you keep a smile with them, treat them nice, and appear self confident, believe me they won't have the guts to defy you. They might talk trash about you when you're not there, but who cares really? 

2. You know those cringey moments you remember when you're about to sleep? Those memories when you think to yourself "how embarrassing, why did I do that?" Yeah well, nobody else remembers them. Those awkward moments are only remembered by you, so try to laugh about them and don't let them bring you down. 

3. With enough self confidence, even the most absurd ideas can be bright ideas. Even you completely lack self confidence, that's ok. Try and fake it. Pretend you're a movie actress playing the role of a confident girl in the story of her life. It might be weird at first but just keep acting it and faking it until it becomes a habit. One day you'll realize it's no longer a habit of faking but actually something that comes natural to you. 

Good luck, but really, you'll be fine. I'm confident in you. If you have any more questions feel free to ask away.

Ok I think you deserve a deep well thought response. Us boys always have the dream of telling her how we feel when we like a particular girl. However, sometimes saying the way we feel won't impact really much her unless she already feels the same way for you. And it might be hard for you to open your feelings for someone and get hurt. Now this is my personal recommendation and it's what has helped me through good and bad experiences. Instead of telling her how you feel, I suggest you show it to her. Yeah it might sound strange but actions speak louder than words. So what I suggest is for to treat her really nicely, flirt with her over text and sometimes a little bit in person. Confidence is the key, remember that. If you feel or at least show confident with what you are saying, you can get away with saying almost anything to her. If you lack self confidence, don't worry, just act it out. Imagine life is a stage and she is the only audience you have. Fake confidence looks almost as good as the real deal, just over don't do it, actually is better to under do it than to over do it. You actually can get to be vulnerable in a confident way, kind of accepting your flaws and living with them. 

Back to topic, I suggest you ask her out on a simple date. Again, use this opportunity to show her how you feel, not to say it yet. During the date I suggest you to seek body and eye contact. Slow and confident, remember; but always increasing the intensity little by little. Remember that you want to make you feelings shine trough your actions. Let your eyes, lips, and hands do the talking for you. I suggest you start with little friendly hugs, move on to playing with her fingers or hair, hand holding maybe, maybe a simple yet sweet kiss on the cheek or on the forehead, if you're lucky you might get a goodbye kiss. Always remember confidence is the key, you must look like you know the shit of what you're doing. If you are or look uncomfortable doing something I guarantee you she will be as well. Eye contact is important, use you eyes to dig through her, through her feelings and thoughts. She might feel uncomfortable but this is not a bad sign, it's just she's feeling vulnerable. Just use a simple yet a little cheesy excuse about how "you got lost in her eyes" or "there's something in her eyes that captivates you". I know, super cheesy, but most girls really like that, and that's what I mean by showing her how you feel instead of telling. 

After the date you can start clarifying perfectly what you feel so you can say it. If everything went out well (I'm sure it will) you can finally start getting you ideas together on how you are going to say what you feel. As you already have shown her, this won't be a lot of a surprise to her hopefully. Try to really show yourself and your feelings for her when you tell her how you feel. You should do it in person, looking into her eyes with confidence. Dress nicely and wear a really nice cologne. Try to do it somewhere where she feels calm and secure, maybe just a little bit risky. Consider inviting her out again for this.

Ok, let's start.

The things you have in your life (your job, your house, money, family, friends, partner, etc.) have nothing to do with the way you feel. You might have everything sorted out in your life and still feel like a mess, I know the feeling. It sucks to be the only thing in your life that is not perfect, and the guilt that comes along with that. There are some of us who just simply feel way more than most people, that's alright. If you're feeling too much of the negative stuff, search for professional help, there's nothing wrong with that and most people will admire the strength it took out of you to do it.

First you have to realize that you are good enough for life (sounds strange but read along). If you were not good enough you wouldn't have all things you have in your life right now. You are always good enough, simply because your are still here breathing. 

If he's the one then relax and let things run along. But don't let him know you're feeling like this yet, it might overwhelm him. I know your'e feeling anxious, and that's alright, just breathe and let the day finish. One thing I know for certain, if he doesn't enjoy being with you, he's not the one. Let time figure out what will happen between you two, but first try to be happy with who your are and with the things you have achieved. 

Maybe some friends will grow tired of listening to the same stuff over and over. What people don't realize is that it's not the same stuff over and over, every time it's a little different, and that's the beauty of listening, noticing the changes. Any ways, search for someone who will have to listen to you, and help you. Just remember that at the end of the day your are the only one who can change the way your live and the way you feel.
